主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada announced the Notice of Annual Meeting of Common Shareholders and Management Proxy Circular dated February 11, 2019, and the Form of Proxy mailed to Common Shareholders on March 7, 2019. These documents are part of the company's corporate governance disclosures and provide information about the annual meeting and proxy voting process for shareholders. The filings are made under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and are submitted in accordance with Regulation S-T rules. The company's principal executive offices are located in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and Montreal, Quebec, Canada. The filings are signed by Karen E. McCarthy, Senior Vice-President, Associate General Counsel & Secretary, on March 7, 2019. The documents are part of the company's Form 6-K filing with the SEC, which is a report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16. The company does not file annual reports under Form 20-F or Form 40-F. The filings are submitted electronically and do not involve paper submissions under Regulation S-T Rule 101(b)(1) or (b)(7).
